bottleneck_ranking.B_observation: 78/92 (84.78%) wrong B labels occurred despite at least one annotated gold document in persisted retrieval output.
bottleneck_ranking.bottleneck: Post-retrieval evidence-to-verdict path (highest-priority diagnostic target; causal mechanism unproven)
bottleneck_ranking.confidence: Moderate for prioritizing diagnostic investigation; low for causal attribution. A retrieved document may be irrelevant to the specific rationale or not selected/used.
bottleneck_ranking.intervention: Audit/alter one evidence-to-component-to-verdict step in a B+ arm; retain frozen B.

bottleneck_ranking.B_observation: Exact gold rationale sentence overlap among B wrong predictions: 66/92 (71.74%). Selected evidence gold-document overlap among wrong: 17/92.
bottleneck_ranking.C_observation: C exact rationale sentence overlap: 65/91 (71.43%). Selected evidence overlap: 17/91.
bottleneck_ranking.bottleneck: Verifier-cited evidence / passage overlap (not an independent input-selection measure)
bottleneck_ranking.confidence: Moderate/low; artifact fields do not fully identify exactly what spans were actually passed into every internal verifier step.
bottleneck_ranking.intervention: Persist stable candidate, selected chunk and sentence IDs plus verifier input/output mappings in future controlled run.

bottleneck_ranking.B_observation: 14/92 (15.22%) wrong predictions had no gold document among valid persisted retrieved chunks.
bottleneck_ranking.confidence: High for document overlap accounting; it explains only these observed rows under the chosen criterion.
bottleneck_ranking.intervention: Do not lead with retriever tuning; separately evaluate miss subset and reranking only after evidence-to-verdict audit.

improvement_candidates.candidate: Structured evidence-to-component verification / auditable stance aggregation
improvement_candidates.comparability: Preserved with unchanged B and same per-claim runtime inputs.
improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: Most current wrong valid labels still have some annotated gold-document overlap; many wrong outputs are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. This locates the diagnostic priority downstream of retrieval hit, but does not prove verifier reasoning is causal.
improvement_candidates.expected_benefit: Tests whether explicit traceable evidence coverage changes labels. No gain assumed.
improvement_candidates.hypothesis_change: No if mechanism test only; intervention arm is a changed B variant.
improvement_candidates.risk: Changes verification mechanism and output distribution; must keep frozen B as comparator.

improvement_candidates.candidate: Evidence selection traceability / controlled selection-only B+
improvement_candidates.comparability: Keep same retrieval candidates/model/config; B remains baseline.
improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: Top-8 gold document/passage overlap is more frequent than selected evidence overlap in errors; selected field semantics are limited.
improvement_candidates.expected_benefit: Separates failure to surface a candidate from verifier interpretation.
improvement_candidates.hypothesis_change: No, as an isolated selection arm.
improvement_candidates.risk: Selection definition can change the evidence exposure; log exact IDs and freeze other components.

improvement_candidates.candidate: Blinded manual error audit of stratified wrong predictions
improvement_candidates.comparability: Does not change systems; is an annotation study.
improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: Persisted artifacts do not prove entailment, claim interpretation, numerical mismatch, compoundness, or aggregation cause.
improvement_candidates.expected_benefit: Provides human-coded diagnostic labels before any intervention choice.
improvement_candidates.risk: Reviewer subjectivity; use blind rubric, two annotators and adjudication.

improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: Not established; lexical complexity features are only proxies.
improvement_candidates.expected_benefit: Unknown until human audit indicates compound claims.
improvement_candidates.risk: Changes prompts/calls and can confound mechanism.

improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: Retrieval misses explain 14 B and 14 C wrong predictions by document overlap among valid labeled evaluable rows; misses remain but are minority of observed errors.
improvement_candidates.expected_benefit: Could improve retrieval-miss cases; not expected to resolve errors when gold docs already present.
improvement_candidates.hypothesis_change: No if isolated retrieval arm, but broad architecture comparison changes.
improvement_candidates.risk: Changes candidate pool and makes verifier comparisons less controlled.

improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: No model-size counterfactual or evidence to identify capacity as cause.
improvement_candidates.risk: Adds model/provider confounding and new identity/latency constraints.

improvement_candidates.diagnosed_observation: B/C retrieval chunk lists are mostly identical; paired labels/correctness are highly similar. No evidence broad orchestration is the bottleneck.
improvement_candidates.risk: Changes C research architecture and causal attribution.

interpretation_limits: Retrieval relevance/document or sentence overlap does not establish evidence entailment.
Gold evidence overlap in retrieved chunks does not establish that the verifier received or used a complete rationale.
Selected evidence overlap does not establish support/contradiction.
A valid verifier label is not the same as a correct label; insufficient-evidence on a labeled claim is an incorrect prediction under the Phase 11B metric.
Execution failure and interruption are not wrong predictions and are excluded from valid-prediction accuracy denominators.
Unlabeled claims are not incorrect; classification correctness is not applicable.
This fixed development evaluation does not generalize to SciFact test or prove the research hypothesis.
